description: In-memory file system with a file tree UI.

methods.name: addFile(file: TpFile): void
methods.description: Adds a copied file record and refreshes the tree; a duplicate normalized path is ignored.

methods.name: closeFile(path: string): void
methods.description: Removes path from the open files; if it was active, activates another open file or clears the active path.

methods.name: deleteFile(path: string): void
methods.description: Deletes an existing writable file and clears its open/dirty state; missing or readonly files are unchanged.

methods.name: getActivePath(): string | null
methods.description: Returns the active file path, or null when no file is active.

methods.name: getDirtyPaths(): string[]
methods.description: Returns a new array of paths currently marked as modified.

methods.name: getFiles(): TpFile[]
methods.description: Returns copies of all in-memory file records; modifying the returned array does not update the component.

methods.name: getState(): TpFilesystemState
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of copied files and the current active, open and dirty paths.

methods.name: moveFile(oldPath: string, newPath: string): void
methods.description: Renames oldPath to newPath using renameFile(), then emits a move notification with the normalized paths.

methods.name: openFile(path: string, emitEvent = true): void
methods.description: Marks an existing file as open and active. Set emitEvent to false to suppress open/active notifications.

methods.name: readFile(path: string): string | null
methods.description: Returns the content of the normalized file path, or null when no file exists at that path.

methods.name: renameFile(oldPath: string, newPath: string): void
methods.description: Changes the normalized path of a writable file and updates its tracked states. Missing, readonly or unchanged source paths are ignored.

methods.name: setActivePath(path: string | null, emitEvent = true): void
methods.description: Sets an existing file as active, or clears it with null. Set emitEvent to false to suppress the active-file notification.

methods.name: setDirtyPaths(paths: readonly string[]): void
methods.description: Replaces the set of modified-file paths and refreshes the tree; unknown paths are discarded.

methods.name: setFiles(files: readonly TpFile[]): void
methods.description: Replaces the in-memory files with copies, removes states for missing files, refreshes the tree and emits a change event.

methods.name: setState(state: TpFilesystemState): void
methods.description: Replaces files and active, open and dirty paths together; removes paths that no longer exist, refreshes the tree and emits change.

methods.name: writeFile(path: string, content: string): void
methods.description: Replaces an existing writable file content, marks it dirty and emits write/change events. Missing and readonly files are unchanged.

events.name: tp-filesystem-active
events.description: Emitted when the active file changes.

events.name: tp-filesystem-add
events.description: Emitted when a file is added.

events.name: tp-filesystem-change
events.description: Emitted when the file list changes.

events.name: tp-filesystem-delete
events.description: Emitted when a file is deleted.

events.name: tp-filesystem-move
events.description: Emitted when a file is moved.

events.name: tp-filesystem-open
events.description: Emitted when a file is opened.

events.name: tp-filesystem-rename
events.description: Emitted when a file or directory is renamed.

events.name: tp-filesystem-write
events.description: Emitted when file content is written.

cssproperties.description: Font size used by the file system.

cssproperties.description: Line height used by the file system.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-filesystem>` element implements the <tp-icon name="filesystem" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Filesystem functionality: in-memory file system with a file tree UI.
